home.title: Snoochie Soft: small Android apps, made properly
home.description: Snoochie Soft is a tiny independent studio publishing Android apps on Google Play: Szybciej Się Nie Da, Mossy, Fake Chat Maker, Loopclass, Offline Audio Transcriber and Christian Pray Everyday.
home.ogAlt: Snoochie Soft: small apps, made properly. Six numbered app covers, SNS-001 to SNS-006, on a chartreuse ground.
home.lede: A tiny independent studio putting out Android apps on Google Play, one numbered release at a time.
home.crateHint: Pick an app to see its screens. Arrow keys move through the list.
home.catSub: Every app gets the next number and keeps it. The sheet grows as releases come out, and the next line is already ruled.
home.rulesSub: Three promises we press into our releases. Each app page lists the ones it keeps, in its own words.

rules.p: Open the app and use it. No sign-up wall and nothing to log in to before you can try it.
Notes, games and recordings stay on your phone and keep working on a plane, on a train or with the Wi-Fi off.
What an app costs is shown before you pay. No surprise walls, no guilt trips, no shaming.

home.contactText: Bug reports, partnerships, press, or a feature you are missing. One inbox, read by the people who build the apps.

ssnd.name: Szybciej Się Nie Da
ssnd.line: English without grammar for Polish speakers: the 500 most common words in 50 days, 10 a day.
ssnd.title: Szybciej Się Nie Da: 500 English words in 50 days, for Polish speakers
ssnd.description: An Android app that teaches Polish speakers the 500 most common English words, 10 a day for 50 days, without grammar rules. App UI in Polish, no account, works offline.
ssnd.languageNote: The app is in Polish: it is made for Polish speakers learning English.
sideA: The 500 most common English words, 10 new ones a day for 50 days
Every word with a recorded voice and an example sentence
Reviews come back just as you start to forget a word
Six ways to practise: flashcards, quiz, matching pairs, listening, typing and a hands-free voice mode
A streak with one grace day, XP, levels and badges
sideB: No account needed. Google sign-in only if you want to sync devices
Works offline
No ads for the first 14 days, then ads only with your consent
All 500 words are free. Premium adds pace (20 or 30 a day), the wider dictionary and no ads
Dark mode, larger text, screen reader support and vibration as an extra cue
notes: Why 500 words: counted on 735 million words of film and TV dialogue, the 500 most common words make up 79.5% of what is said. The first 100 alone cover 64%.
The sources and the method are in the app, on a screen of their own.
ssnd.fine: Prices are shown in Google Play before you buy. Monthly and yearly Premium start with 7 days free; there is also a one-time purchase.

mossy.name: Mossy
mossy.kind: Cosy games for focus and calm
mossy.line: Your brain isn't broken. It just has 47 tabs open. Sixteen cosy mini-games for adults with ADHD, 1 to 3 minutes a round.
mossy.title: Mossy: cosy ADHD games for adults. Offline, no ads
mossy.description: Mossy is 16 tiny, cosy games for focus and calm, made for adult ADHD brains. 1 to 3 minutes a round, 6 games free forever, works offline, no ads, no account, no subscription.
sideA: 16 tiny games, 1 to 3 minutes a round
Learn any game in about 10 seconds
Games adapt quietly, so they stay just challenging enough
Today's Mix: three games picked for you each day
Music generated as you play, so it never loops the same ten notes
A little forest garden grows as you play
sideB: 6 games free, forever. Try each locked game once, free
Full Unlock: all 16 games for one payment, no subscription
Works offline. No ads, no account, no tracking
No streaks to lose and no shame screens
Reduced motion, colour-blind mode and adjustable haptics
notes: Moss doesn't die when you forget it. It just waits. Show up when you can; your garden will still be there.
Your scores, badges and garden are saved only on your phone. The one outside party is Google Play, which handles the Full Unlock purchase.
mossy.fine: Mossy is a set of games for focus and relaxation. It isn't a medical device and doesn't diagnose, treat or cure any condition.

fakechat.name: Fake Chat Maker & Text Message
fakechat.kind: Fake chats for jokes and stories
fakechat.line: Write a fake text conversation for a joke or a story, style it and save it as a picture. Made for fun only.
fakechat.title: Fake Chat Maker & Text Message: fake chats for jokes and stories
fakechat.description: Make a fake text conversation, style it and save it as a picture. Three chat styles, your own background, no account, works offline. For fun only. Android app by Snoochie Soft.
sideA: Write both sides of a chat. Tap a bubble to edit it, long press to switch the sender
Change the time and the delivered or read ticks
Drag to reorder messages, undo and redo any change
Three chat styles and your own background: colour, gradient or a photo
Save the chat as a picture and share it, or back it up to a file
sideB: No account, no sign-in, works offline
No limit on chats or messages in the free version
Ads never appear while you type or edit
One small purchase removes the ads and the watermark for good
Sends no real messages and connects to no messaging service
notes: Good for a prank on your friends, a story post, or a mock-up for a video, a school project or a presentation.
fakechat.fine: For fun and creative storytelling only. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to any messaging app or company. Please do not use screenshots to deceive, harass or harm anyone.

loopclass.name: Loopclass
loopclass.line: Your timetable, homework, exams and grades in one planner, with widgets and reminders. Works without an account and without internet.
loopclass.title: Loopclass: class schedule, homework and grades planner for Android
loopclass.description: Loopclass keeps your school timetable, homework, exams and grades in one planner, with widgets and reminders. No account, works offline, optional backup to your own Google Drive.
sideA: A weekly timetable with rooms, teachers and A/B weeks
Homework and exams with several reminders each
Grades with weights, averages and GPA: percent, letters A–F or the Polish 1–6 scale
Home screen widgets: your next class with a countdown, and your open tasks
Today's ring closes when every task due today is done
sideB: No account and no internet needed
Optional backup to your own private Google Drive folder
No server of ours: your planner stays on your device
Every planner feature is free, with one small banner ad
A one-time Premium purchase removes the ad. No subscription
notes: Overdue tasks get a calm label, never a red counter. Every effect has its own switch, plus Minimum and Maximum presets.
Reminders are scheduled again after a restart, and class times stay put when you change time zones.
loopclass.fine: Made for high school and college students (13+). Ads are served by Google AdMob.

transcriber.name: Offline Audio Transcriber
transcriber.kind: Speech to text on your phone
transcriber.line: Turn voice notes, lectures, interviews and any MP3 or video file into text on your Android phone. Nothing is uploaded.
transcriber.title: Offline Audio Transcriber for Android: speech to text, no upload
transcriber.description: Turn recordings, MP3 and video files into text on your Android phone. Offline transcription in 24 languages, no account, nothing uploaded.
sideA: Record, or import MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, MP4 and other audio and video files
A timestamped transcript that follows the audio. Tap a word to jump there
Fix mistakes, search the text and sort recordings into folders
Export TXT, SRT or VTT, copy or share
24 European languages with the main model; an optional second model adds more
sideB: No account and no server of ours
Works offline once the 671 MB speech model is on the phone
Goes online only for the model download, ads and Google Play purchases
The first 2 minutes of every recording are free; a short ad adds 3 minutes
Minute packs never expire; Pro gives unlimited minutes
notes: On a Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra a one-hour recording took about 8 minutes in our own test. Older and cheaper phones are slower, and long jobs keep running in the background.
No analytics, no crash reporting, nothing sold.
transcriber.fine: Accuracy depends on audio quality, accents and background noise. Check important transcripts before you rely on them. The main speech model, NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3, is licensed under CC BY 4.0.

christianpray.name: Christian Pray Everyday
christianpray.line: A daily Bible verse read aloud, 25 recorded prayers and 215 Bible stories. A quiet place to begin and end your day.
christianpray.title: Christian Pray Everyday: daily Bible verse, prayers and stories
christianpray.description: A daily Bible verse read aloud, 25 recorded prayers and 215 Bible stories, with the church year and a home screen widget. Android app by Snoochie Soft.
sideA: One verse each day, read aloud, with a painted picture behind it
More than 13,000 verses and four natural voices to choose from
25 recorded prayers: press play and pray along
215 Bible stories, from Creation to Paul's last journey
Scripture for more than 1,100 topics, from grief to grace
The church year, feast by feast (US calendar), and a verse widget
sideB: The verse of the day is free to hear, no subscription needed
66 stories free to read, three free to hear
Premium: weekly, monthly or yearly, renewing until you cancel it in Google Play
Saved verses, prayers and your streak live in your own Google account backup, not on our servers
No ads
notes: Everything is set in one calm book that hangs in the sky, page by page.
Premium members can share one prayer intention a day. Every intention is read by a person before anyone else sees it.
christianpray.fine: Premium opens every voice, every story and every topic. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period.
